title: AE Install Ride-Along Observation Workbook
description: Field observation workbook for new Account Executives shadowing JCI install activities across their first weeks. Complete each section as you attend the meeting, shadow the install manager, and ride along with a technician.
author: JCI ASCEND Learning

questions.prompt: Date of the install team meeting
questions.helpText: Use the date the meeting took place.

questions.prompt: What was discussed in the meeting?
questions.helpText: Summarize scope, safety, roles, and schedule.

questions.prompt: How many install jobs did you review this week?
How confident do you feel about the install handoff process?
Describe one thing you learned from the manager
Did you complete a full ride-along day?
Rate your understanding of on-site install steps
Link to your ride-along notes or photos
questions.helpText: Paste a SharePoint or Teams link starting with https://

questions.prompt: Notes and observations from the ride along
